Kruunupyy is 109 road km from its nearest unit by drive time, so 15 breast sessions mean 16 nights away versus 6 with 5 sessions [S60, S59].

1. The head of radiotherapy could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as the default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases: equal pain relief, more retreatment [S31, S30, S62]. For Kruunupyy, expected nights away are 6.2 with a multi-fraction course versus 2.4 with a single 8 Gy session [S60, S30]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews this default for uncomplicated cases [S31, S30]. It serves "National targets and key effectiveness indicators defined for agreed cancers" [S61].

2. The breast clinic lead could evaluate 5 sessions as the default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall without nodal radiotherapy), which is non-inferior to 15 sessions [S9, S11, S15]. Distance is a reason to choose it, and for breast alone the county would remove 58 nights away and free 544 machine sessions yearly (calculated) [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligibility [S15, S14]. It serves "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S25, S24].

3. The quality manager could evaluate reporting schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band yearly [S21, S27]. Within 30 days, the quality manager and the clinical team decide which figures to report [S21, S27]. It serves "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S26].

Distances use municipality centre points, and the current schedule mix is unknown [S59, S57, S60].
